classifiedFinding.title: Owner-only entrypoints (topUp, setTargetAPY, setDispatcherIndex, setNFTMinter, setDispatcherHook, setStakedId, pullAndRefresh) lack nonReentrant; relies on owner trust

classification.assetImpact: None under standard owner-trust assumptions. Defensive-depth gap on owner-only paths that call _syncBudget (and therefore dispatcherHook.pull()).
attackPath: None observed under standard owner-trust assumptions. A re-entrant call from pull() back into an owner-only function would only succeed if msg.sender remains the owner.
classification.assumptions: Owner key is honest; dispatcher hook is in the same trust domain.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low / defensive-depth note. Owner-only paths are gated by onlyOwner and the dispatcher hook is in the same trust domain. Recommendation: add nonReentrant to pullAndRefresh and the setters that call _syncBudget for defensive depth at minimal cost.
